load_dataset_samples: load RGB images, surface normals, and masks from directory structure into a dataset for training
get_sample_by_index: retrieve a specific sample by index with its image, normal map, mask, and bounding box
normalize_surface_normals: normalize surface normal vectors to unit length when they fall outside the expected tolerance range
compute_bounding_box: compute the bounding box coordinates from a binary mask by finding foreground pixel extents
register_dataset_module: register the NormalGeneralDataset class with the mmseg DATASETS registry for use in segmentation pipelines
